title: CI has more than the one allowed partner
cardHint: A CI has more partners than the model allows, such as an offering with two Business Services. SACM fixes the mapping.
cardText: An offering has exactly one Business Service; a Service Instance exactly one Business Application; a Business Application one Service Instance per environment. SACM fixes the mapping in ServiceNow: use the fix list. When SACM cannot tell which one is right, open the CI and press "Cannot tell which one is right: ask the owner": the owner is asked.

playbook.askWhenUnsure: Cannot tell which one is right: ask the owner

message.subject: Too many related CIs
message.intro: These CIs are related to more CIs than the CMDB model allows. The table shows which.
message.ask: Which one is right? {Reply}, and SACM removes the other relationships in ServiceNow.
message.why: With two parents, criticality and ownership are not clear.
